snippet.title: Plains of Pain – Survivor’s Guide Part 1: Wasteland Basics
snippet.description:
Plains of Pain – Survivor’s Guide Part 1: Wasteland Basics

Start your journey in the scorched morning of the wasteland. Learn how to craft a pickaxe, gather small stones, and build your first Rock Stash.

Meet Frank and Ron—old C8 units with a camp that might buy you time before you head out alone. Face lowlifes, loot what you can, and stash what you can’t carry.

This is the start of mastering survival. The rest… you’ll have to find on your own.
